mechanism: Both agents can cause acute kidney injury and hypocalcemia; lisinopril increases renal hypoperfusion risk while zoledronic acid is nephrotoxic, particularly with pre-existing renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) before and periodically during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration during zoledronic acid infusion and assess ACE inhibitor necessity in patients with renal disease.
